text:
sara: Heads-up — new kernel comparison across H100 (us-west), L40 (eu-central), and A100 (ap-southeast). Trying to decide when to flip to FlashAttention v3 vs stick with Triton vendor kernels for q8 models. Data in-line.

jordan: cool, TL;DR numbers? p50/p95 tokens/ms or latency?

sara: p50/p95 generation latency for a 2k-seq causal model (q8_0 quant):
```
H100 + FlashAttention v3: p50 8.6ms, p95 28.9ms, throughput 420 tok/s per GPU
H100 + Triton-fused: p50 9.8ms, p95 34.1ms, throughput 390 tok/s
L40 + FlashAttention v3: p50 10.5ms, p95 36.0ms, throughput 360 tok/s
L40 + Vendor-fp16-kernel: p50 9.9ms, p95 33.2ms, throughput 370 tok/s
A100 + FlashAttention v2: p50 11.3ms, p95 40.1ms, throughput 330 tok/s
```

devon: interesting — on L40 the vendor kernel is slightly better than FA v3 in p95. region/network noise?

sara: bench was local inside region VPC, 1000 samples per config, pinned affinity. We saw consistent tail behavior. Also note that FA v3 improves memory and supports better KV-cache reuse which impacts throughput under high-concurrency.

kevin: what's the quant profile? q8_0 for all? any q4 experiments?

sara: yes q8_0 for above. Quick q4_0 spot-check on H100 + FAv3: p50 10.0ms, p95 35.4ms, throughput 480 tok/s (lower precision but throughput up). Quality delta measured on eval set: sacreBLEU -0.4 relative to fp16.

jordan: So tradeoffs: FA v3 -> better mem & throughput on H100, but vendor kernel still wins on L40 p95. We need a rule for routing.

sara: propose policy: prefer FlashAttention v3 on H100 and L4 (if driver supports it) for baseline serving. Fallback to vendor kernel in eu-central (L40) when observed p95 > target. Add region-level heuristic: if region p95 consistently exceeds SLA by >10% for 5m, switch route to Triton vendor lib.

devon: +1 but add cost delta: vendor kernel on L40 reduces burst capacity needs so might save on infra. Can we get cost-per-token delta?

sara: quick calc: using our metrics, FAFv3 on H100 cuts tokens/GPU-hour by ~12% vs Triton; on L40 vendor kernel is ~4% cheaper effective cost because lower tail requires fewer replicas. I can attach the spreadsheet.

ml-bench-bot: uploaded benchmark artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/1782603345/kernel-combo/report.html (summary + charts) :white_check_mark:

kevin: operational notes: when we flip kernel at routing layer we need warmup policy: pre-populate KV caches and do 2-min canary with p95/latency checks. Also ensure metrics have kernel tag for cost attribution.

jordan: Agree. Suggestion: implement staged rollout across zones: 1) canary 1% of traffic, 2) 10% after 15m, 3) 100% after 1h if p95 stable. Also telemetry: p99, auth errors, OOMs.

sara: will iterate on the rollout plan and add a small test harness to re-run the L40 vendor kernel in eu-central during low-traffic window to validate tail improvement. Planning to open a PR with routing config + bench artifacts.

devon: tiny gotcha — FA v3 currently requires driver >= 535.x on some cloud images. Make sure image compatibility check is in the rollout.

sara: noted, will add preflight in the PR. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
